## Description

Multiple-inheritance entities are encoded as parts whitespace-separated inside outer parens — `#1=( A() B() C() )`. Defects: (a) non-alphabetical order (spec requires alphabetic on external mapping); (b) parts may carry `/* PARENT_A+PARENT_C */` label comments; (c) entity references inside nested aggregates within one part must still be ID-resolved on file-merge; (d) "AND" complex types may collide on a single `step_id` in factory dispatch.

## Reproducer recipe

`#10=( CONVERSION_BASED_UNIT('DEG',#9) NAMED_UNIT(*) PLANE_ANGLE_UNIT() );` and the same with parts in non-alphabetic order.

## Expected kernel behavior

Accept space-separated record list; sort internally for dispatch; preserve order on round-trip; warn on non-alphabetic input but do not reject; resolve every `#` reference inside arbitrarily nested aggregates.

**Structured outcomes** (extracted from prose; for downstream auto-grading):
- allowed: `reject`
